title: Honesty without an opportunity
odia: ଧନ ନ ପଡିଲେ ଚୋର ବି ସାଧୁ।
literal_meaning: If wealth does not come [within reach], even a thief is honest.
meaning_odia: ଧନ ହାତକୁ ଆସିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ ନଥିଲେ ଚୋର ମଧ୍ୟ ସାଧୁ ପରି ରହେ ବୋଲି ଏହି କଥା କହୁଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ସୁଯୋଗ ନମିଳିବା ଓ ସୁଯୋଗ ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅସାଧୁ କାମ ନକରିବା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଫରକ ଅଛି। ଏଠାରେ ଧନ ନଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଚୋର କୁହାଯାଉନାହିଁ; ମୂଳର ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଚୋର ବୋଲି ବର୍ଣ୍ଣିତ।
explanation: The condition comes before the praise: nothing tempting has come within reach. Our editorial reading distinguishes conduct that has faced an opportunity from conduct that has never been tested by one. The line’s thief is already identified as such; it is not evidence for accusing an untested person of dishonesty.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone is praised for never misusing funds they have never handled. Another person recalls the saying and asks whether that record actually demonstrates restraint.
cultural_context: ଚୋର and ସାଧୁ create a sharp moral opposition within one short sentence. The missing opportunity, expressed by ଧନ ନ ପଡିଲେ, makes it possible for the same figure to occupy both descriptions.
